purpose: Create and assess a strict-OOF, target-free orthogonal O3 meta family as a new MC1 input, with a fair common-ID comparison against the current live stack.

scope.promotion: blocked pending a later untouched period

contracts.o3_train: six preceding resolved calendar months, 28-day reserve purge, policy labels/path semantics available before reserve start
contracts.o3_inference: five target-free head scores, their ranks, consensus rank and rank dispersion only
contracts.mc1: separate six-month chronological current and BCF maps with prior-resolved 21-day shift
contracts.admission: both experimental MC1 expected values >= 30 bps
contracts.auction: one global constrained 7x / 10%-margin-slot / 80%-margin portfolio, priority BCF experimental mapped EV
contracts.economic_outcome: canonical reconciled rich policy net; all selected portfolio trades resolved

fairness.comparison: O3 matched stack minus current live baseline

result.decision: retain as frozen offline challenger; 2026 worst-month delta is -6.732242 bps/trade despite aggregate/drawdown gains

validation.target_free_panel_audit: 13 O3 monthly panels, Jul-2025 through Jul-2026: no prohibited policy/semantic columns; score-field coverage minimum 100% each month
validation.selected_outcome_audit: 0 unresolved selected outcomes in each of baseline/challenger x 2025-Q4/2026-Apr-Jul
